summary: 12 cases, 506 checks, 44 individually checked Y+RGB pixels, 37 client words and 37 app words; compile/sim Errors0 Warnings0.

source_extraction.slice: From reg copy_pixel_pending through v_rd_addr assignment; the only declaration adaptation exposes color_word_active as a probe input, no logic change.
Exact vision_read_owner/drain_admission_safe predicates, vision_read_outstanding always block, and rd_req/rd_byte_addr/v_rd_ready/v_rd_valid/v_rd_data assignments.

late_reply_assertions: During explicit/KEY4 cancel, an attempted normal start and normal pixel request are held while the old doc read is pending. Every remaining response-cycle and the pixel-valid edge assert old document owner, purpose=2, frame lock and pixel pending; client transaction count cannot increase. The old pixel is checked against its original expected coordinate/generation. Only after drain releases the owner is a new-generation normal pixel requested and checked.

prior_evidence.scope: Old standalone reader bench checks immediate word response/all Y lanes/odd RGB/cache/last address/frame invalidation; source and bench alone do not establish current top coverage.
Prior 13-case real-reader/old-auto-pipeline cancel drain control PASS. Its old pipeline/top integration is not current r4, and DDR words were supplied by bench.
Current-source top ownership/control probes, with manually driven reader ready/valid; complementary control-only evidence.
Current r4 model pipeline values/cancel/reentry, but abstract 2..4-cycle pixel reader rather than actual reader/mailbox.

remaining_limits: Behavioral app ready/data model, not vendor controller/PHY, no physical DDR latency or hardware CDC proof.
Top and HXA routing slices are source extracted; this is not full secondary_top/HXA state machine elaboration.
Normal/doc/PCB ownership inputs and CRC scanner state are controlled; admission protocol has separate packet/control regressions.
No complete model inference in this test; r4 fullpipeline separately checks values with abstract pixel reader.
Only fixed 8ns/14ns clocks and selected digital ready/response schedules were simulated; no metastability, analog margin, or exhaustive clock phase proof.
No complete 1280-fragment image DMA, full camera/YUYV/HXA/DDR/inference/OSD path, or multi-frame hardware replay is claimed.
